regions.label: iNESHeader
regions.evidence: NES magic and declared PRG/CHR section sizes, mapper 4; inspect metadata agrees with whole file length.

regions.label: CHRTilePlanes
regions.evidence: iNES declares 128 KiB CHR ROM; NES PPU pattern storage uses 16-byte two-plane 8x8 tiles. Physical section, not CPU instructions; no PRG overlap.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Hardware NMI/reset/IRQ vector slots $FFFA-$FFFF in fixed last PRG bank; values $CA73/$FF30/$D015. Reset fetch confirmed by startup contexts. Three little-endian CPU pointers.

regions.label: StageBankSelectorBytes
regions.evidence: Physical bytes between preceding RTS at $1C905 and supported initialization routine at $1C912; low repeated selector bytes 02,02,03,03,04,05... . Consumer $C8E6 loads $02C0 then indexed $C8F6,Y (physical $1C906+Y), passes value to mapper helper. Successful level indices 0..6 demonstrate prefix role; exact full selector-table extent and later entries unclaimed. Whole 12-byte interval is non-code generic selector-related data, not a 12-record schema.
